proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you provide a small, shareable Parquet sample (or a Python snippet that writes equivalent Parquet files) that still triggers this error when using `read_parquet(...)`, together with the complete Python traceback produced? A minimal reproducer that shows which file/column causes the cast-to-NULL error will let maintainers reproduce and confirm an improved error message.
proposal.rationale: Report describes an in-scope failure (read_parquet across files) but lacks any shareable input or minimal reproducer; without a sample Parquet file or equivalent code producing the same error and the full traceback, maintainers cannot follow the failure to identify which file/column triggers the cast-to-NULL ConversionException.
